_s26_beds: 26.1.2 -> 26.2 beds (s26b, queue item 3): 26.2 draws its beds as block models (blockstates/<colour>_bed.json -> models/block/<colour>_bed_head|foot, parent template_bed_head|foot; items a composite of the two) and dropped the bed block entity, its renderer, the item model type minecraft:bed, the bed layers and the bed atlas. A 26.1.2 mod's bed was drawn from its block entity by BedRenderer; the layer keeps that path for the beds such a mod makes (see rt/CbS26Beds, rt/CbS26BedsClient, facade/Bed*)

_classRenames_basis.net/minecraft/world/level/block/entity/B: 26.2 has no bed block entity; the facade is 26.1.2's class body (javap), of the layer's BED type
_classRenames_basis.net/minecraft/client/renderer/blockentit: 26.2 has no bed renderer; the facade is 26.1.2's body on the 26.2 members that took the same calls (bed layers and sprites given back by rt/CbS26BedsClient)
_classRenames_basis.net/minecraft/client/renderer/special/Be: 26.2 has no bed special renderer; 26.1.2's body over facade/BedRenderer
26.1.2's record and MAP_CODEC, registered as item model type minecraft:bed (mixin/CbS26BedSpecialMixin)

_superRenames_basis.net/minecraft/world/level/block/BedBlock: 26.2's BedBlock is no EntityBlock (newBlockEntity gone, javap); a 26.1.2 mod's subclass extends facade/BedBlock: 26.2's BedBlock that still makes 26.1.2's bed block entity, so its renderer draws it as on 26.1.2. 26.2's own beds are untouched

_ctorRedirects_basis.net/minecraft/world/level/block/BedBlock: a 26.1.2 mod's own new BedBlock(color, properties) was an EntityBlock with a bed block entity (26.1.2 BedBlock implements EntityBlock); it gets facade/BedBlock, a 26.2 BedBlock that still is one

_instanceRedirects_basis.net/minecraft/world/level/block/BedBlock: the bed's own newBlockEntity where it is an EntityBlock (a mod's bed, facade/BedBlock), else 26.1.2's body new BedBlockEntity(pos, state, color); a mod's super call goes to the facade (superRenames)

_fieldGetters_basis.BlockEntityType.BED: 26.1.2's type, registered as minecraft:bed with the sixteen vanilla beds valid (mixin/CbS26BedTypeMixin)
_fieldGetters_basis.Sheets / AtlasIds / ModelLayers: 26.2 has no bed atlas or bed layers: the layer's resources add 26.1.2's entity/bed source to the block atlas (atlases/blocks.json), and its layers are added to 26.2's layer definitions (mixin/CbS26BedLayersMixin); see rt/CbS26BedsClient
